title: Brutal Mr Jack Nic Salt 10ml E-Liquid By Just Juice
description: Brutal's Mr Black e-liquid is a deliciously bold candy flavour that will take you back in time to the sweet shops of yesteryear. Its perfectly balanced blend of sweet, spicy liquorice and warming aniseed creates a deeply flavoursome experience that will delight your taste buds. The sweet and punchy inhale transitions smoothly into a herby exhale, making for a perfectly balanced and satisfying vaping experience. Indulge in the bold and delightful taste of Mr Black from Brutal and treat yourself to a moment of sweet nostalgia. Brutal's range of nic salt e-liquids offers a perfect balance of flavour, vapour production, and throat hit with their 50VG/50PG blend. Designed for e-cigarette starter kits and pod vape devices, these e-liquids come in 11mg and 20mg nicotine strengths, making them an excellent choice for vapers who seek immediate relief from nicotine cravings. Nicotine Salt e-liquids have a unique alkaline formulation that delivers a higher concentration of nicotine compared to regular freebase e-liquids. They provide a smooth throat hit at higher nicotine concentrations and are absorbed faster into the bloodstream. As a result, these e-liquids are ideal for recent ex-smokers or vapers seeking satisfying nicotine relief with a smooth throat hit. Brutal e-liquid is a delicious new collection of e-liquids from UK's e-juice masters Just Juice. They are available in long-lasting 100ml shortfills and intensely satisfying Nic Salts. The range features five classic sweetshop flavours that are sure to light up your taste buds in a glow of warm memories. Brutal e-liquid's nostalgic favourites include Rhubarb and Custard, Red & Black's raspberry and blackcurrant gummies, Mr Jack's liquorice and aniseed, Sour Strawberry Bubblegum, and Raspberry Sour chew bars. Each Brutal vape flavour will transport you back to the carefree days of childhood when a visit to the tuck shop was the highlight of the day.
